caption:
Vague manager talk feels nicer in the moment, but it makes the next miss more likely. The kind move is to say the actual ask out loud.

Save this for the next time you’re about to soften the point too much.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #feedback

messages.name: You say
messages.text: “When you get a chance, can you send that over?”

messages.name: You mean
messages.text: “I needed it already, and I’m trying not to sound annoyed.”

messages.name: You mean
messages.text: “There were mistakes. Slow down before you hit send.”

messages.name: You mean
messages.text: “This is a problem now, and I need it fixed.”

slides.headline: Say the <u>actual ask</u>.
slides.sub: Soft words feel kind. Clear words help.
